verses.text: He saith to them: Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and you shall find. They cast therefore; and now they were not able to draw it, for the multitude of fishes.
verses.note: The risen Jesus tells the disciples where to cast the net, and the catch is too great to draw in.

verses.text: And Simon answering said to him: Master, we have labored all the night, and have taken nothing: but at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.note: Simon has taken nothing all the night, yet lets down the net at Jesus' word.

verses.text: And he saith to them: Come ye after me, and I will make you to be fishers of men.
verses.note: Jesus invites them to come after him and promises to make them fishers of men.

verses.text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, one hundred and fifty-three. And although there were so many, the net was not broken.
verses.note: The net holds one hundred and fifty-three great fishes, and it is not broken.

verses.text: Jesus saith to them: Come, and dine. And none of them who were at meat, durst ask him: Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.note: The risen Lord invites his disciples to eat with him, and they know that it is the Lord.

verses.text: He said to him the third time: Simon, son of John, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved, because he had said to him the third time: Lovest thou me? And he said to him: Lord, thou knowest all things: thou knowest that I love thee. He said to him: Feed my sheep.
verses.note: For the third time Jesus asks Peter if he loves him; Peter answers that the Lord knows all things, and Jesus tells him to feed his sheep.

verses.text: And immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying: Be of good heart: it is I, fear ye not.
verses.note: Jesus speaks to his disciples at once: be of good heart, it is I.

verses.text: And immediately Jesus stretching forth his hand took hold of him, and said to him: O thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt?
verses.note: Jesus takes hold of him immediately and asks why he doubted.

verses.text: And I say to thee: That thou art Peter; and upon this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.note: Jesus says he will build his church upon this rock, and that the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.text: Simon Peter answered and said: Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.note: Simon Peter confesses that Jesus is Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.text: And Simon Peter answered him: Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.note: Simon Peter answers that the Lord has the words of eternal life.

verses.text: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and thou, being once converted, confirm thy brethren.
verses.note: Jesus says he has prayed that this faith fail not, and that, once converted, he should confirm his brethren.

verses.text: And rising up, he rebuked the wind, and said to the sea: Peace, be still. And the wind ceased: and there was made a great calm.
verses.note: Jesus rebukes the wind and says to the sea: Peace, be still; and there is a great calm.

verses.text: And he said to them: Why are you fearful? have you not faith yet? And they feared exceedingly: and they said one to another: Who is this (thinkest thou) that both wind and sea obey him?
verses.note: Jesus asks why they are fearful, and they wonder who this is that wind and sea obey.

verses.text: Again the kingdom of heaven is like to a net cast into the sea, and gathering together of all kind of fishes.
verses.note: Jesus compares the kingdom of heaven to a net cast into the sea that gathers all kinds of fishes.

verses.text: Now the Lord prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonas: and Jonas was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.note: The Lord prepares a great fish, and Jonah is in its belly three days and three nights.

verses.text: For as Jonas was in the whale's belly three days and three nights: so shall the Son of man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
verses.note: Jesus compares Jonah in the whale's belly to the Son of man in the heart of the earth, three days and three nights.

verses.text: There is a boy here that hath five barley loaves, and two fishes; but what are these among so many?
verses.note: There are five barley loaves and two fishes; what are these among so many?

verses.text: And they offered him a piece of a broiled fish, and a honeycomb. And when he had eaten before them, taking the remains, he gave to them.
verses.note: The risen Jesus eats before his disciples.

verses.text: He will turn again, and have mercy on us: he will put away our iniquities: and he will cast all our sins into the bottom of the sea.
verses.note: The prophet says the Lord will have mercy and cast all our sins into the bottom of the sea.

verses.text: Casting all your care upon him, for he hath care of you.
verses.note: Peter tells believers to cast their care upon God, who cares for them.

verses.text: But sanctify the Lord Christ in your hearts, being ready always to satisfy every one that asketh you a reason of that hope which is in you.
verses.note: Peter tells believers to be always ready to give a reason for the hope that is in them.

verses.text: Be still and see that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, and I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.note: God invites us to be still and see that he is God.

verses.text: When thou shalt pass through the waters, I will be with thee, and the rivers shall not cover thee: when thou shalt walk in the fire, thou shalt not be burnt, and the flames shall not burn in thee:
verses.note: God promises to be with his people when they pass through the waters.

verses.text: A psalm for David. The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.
verses.note: A psalm for David: because the Lord rules him, he shall want nothing.

verses.text: Come to me, all you that labour, and are burdened, and I will refresh you.
verses.note: Jesus invites all who labor and are burdened to come to him.

verses.text: Jesus saith to him: I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No man cometh to the Father, but by me.
verses.note: Jesus says he is the way, the truth, and the life, and that no man comes to the Father but by him.

verses.text: Again therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me, walketh not in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.note: Jesus says he is the light of the world.

verses.text: For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son; that whosoever believeth in him, may not perish, but may have life everlasting.
verses.note: God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten Son.

verses.text: I am the vine: you the branches: he that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.
verses.note: Jesus is the vine and we are the branches; without him we can do nothing.

verses.text: Going therefore, teach ye all nations; baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost. Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and behold I am with you all days, even to the consummation of the world.
verses.note: The risen Lord sends his disciples to teach all nations, and promises to be with them all days.

verses.text: You are the light of the world. A city seated on a mountain cannot be hid.
verses.note: Jesus tells his hearers that they are the light of the world.

verses.text: Because no word shall be impossible with God.
verses.note: No word shall be impossible with God.

verses.text: And we know that to them that love God, all things work together unto good, to such as, according to his purpose, are called to be saints.
verses.note: Paul writes that all things work together unto good for those who love God.

verses.text: I can do all these things in him who strengtheneth me.
verses.note: Paul writes that he can do all these things in him who strengthens him.

verses.text: I say to you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven upon one sinner that doth penance, more than upon ninety-nine just who need not penance.
verses.note: Jesus says there is joy in heaven over one sinner who does penance.

verses.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we saw his glory, the glory as it were of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.note: The Word was made flesh and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth.

verses.text: Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.
verses.note: Jesus teaches us to ask, to seek, and to knock.

verses.text: Jesus saith to him: Because thou hast seen me, Thomas, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and have believed.
verses.note: Jesus tells Thomas that those who have not seen and have believed are blessed.
